description: Diagnostic investigation of computed_loss_ratio = PRD_INCRD_LOSSES_AMT / PRD_ERND_PREM_AMT. Triggered by implausibly large positive and negative yearly averages in eda_summary.json. Analysis covers all rows where PRD_ERND_PREM_AMT > 0, including COMMPOL and zero-WP rows, to capture the full scope of the instability before any modeling filters are applied.

small_denominator_analysis.description: Among rows where |computed_loss_ratio| > 10: distribution of PRD_ERND_PREM_AMT vs normal rows (|LR| <= 2).

raw_vs_computed_comparison.interpretation: The raw LOSS_RATIO column uses sentinel values (99997/99998/99999) to mask rows where the loss ratio is undefined, infinite, or otherwise flagged. computed_loss_ratio = PRD_INCRD_LOSSES_AMT / PRD_ERND_PREM_AMT exposes those values directly. Rows where the raw column is sentinel and the computed ratio is extreme (|LR|>10) reveal cases the dataset originally suppressed.
